info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Counterparty Administration-spec
info.description: The Market Data Counterparty Administration API allows users to manage counterparty information within the market data framework. This API is designed for financial institutions and data administrators who need to create and maintain records of counterparties involved in market transactions. Operations include adding new counterparties and updating existing ones, ensuring that market data is accurate and up-to-date. This API is essential for regulatory compliance and risk management, catering to developers integrating market data solutions in their applications.

post.summary: Create a new counterparty administration entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new counterparty administration record in the market data system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully add a new entry.
